create_lm_model: create an LM model with params, encoder, and decoder for language modeling
run_lm_forward: run the LM forward pass with input tensor, lengths, source, is_encoder, and reverse flags
build_sublm_language_model: build a SubLM language model with params, model, is_encoder, and reverse for per-language modeling
run_sublm_forward: run the SubLM forward pass with word indices, lengths, and lang_id to get word scores
share_lm_embeddings: share language model embeddings and LSTM parameters with encoder or decoder model
